the GOSAT measurements have a bias of −0.2 ppm with respect to the TCCON network, which is within the expected uncertainty of the TCCON measurements, and that the GOSA_T measurements have an uncertainty of 2 ppm.

we have demonstrated the capability of the GOSAT satellite to retrieve accurate and reliable column-averaged CO2 data with an uncertainty of 2 ppm, and that the data can be used to constrain the surface fluxes of carbon dioxide.

The main takeaway from our work is that
GOSAT XCO2 retrievals are consistent with ground-based TCCON observations, and that GOSAT observations can be used to validate the GEOS-Chem global 3-D model.
the GOSAT data set can be used to validate and improve GEOS-Chem and other chemistry transport models.
